prompts.terrain:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual playable tower-defense level background, portrait 1024x1152. Image 1 is the EXACT LAYOUT GUIDE and must govern composition, geometry and framing. Image 2 is ONLY the woodland art style reference. Transform the layout guide into a finished richly painted soft 3D woodland diorama environment at exactly the same crop and relative geometry. Orthographic front-aligned elevated 42 degree camera. Zero camera roll. NO diamonds, NO perspective convergence.
CRITICAL: preserve the guide's path centerline, widths, turns and positions. The beige road must stay on exactly those same pixels: starts at x9.6%,y26.5%; travels horizontally RIGHT to x70.2%,y26.5%; DOWN to x70.2%,y61.5%; LEFT to x29.8%,y61.5%; DOWN to x29.8%,y89.1%; RIGHT to x90.4%,y89.1%. No extra turns, no disconnected path, no diagonal segments, no narrowing or moving the route. Road roughly 8.4% image width and 5.7% image height thickness; round the corners within this corridor. The two small circles are registration markers; REMOVE both circles in the final image. Do not zoom, rotate, crop or reshape the guide. Outer dark margins are just forest continuation.
STYLE: match the reference's rich tactile painterly 3D miniature quality: irregular warm beige limestone paving with rounded worn edges and cracks, subtle bevels, moss between stones, earthy shoulders blended into varied sage grass. Ground is lush but restrained, fine brushlike texture and visible soft relief, small patches of moss and clover, scattered tiny flowers. Cast consistent soft contact shadows toward lower-right. Common warm daylight from upper-left.
ENVIRONMENT COMPOSITION: fern clusters, tiny mossy stones, short roots, fallen twigs, soft shrubs mostly around outer edges; small forest trees only at extreme top corners, branches framing the view. Central green regions are OPEN CLEARINGS usable for building towers, gently textured with sparse low grass: no large trees, no boulders, no buildings, no obstacles there. The road is clear and walkable throughout. Keep lower-right destination clearing unobstructed for a castle that will be added by code. The left entrance is unobstructed: do not add a portal or arch. A subtle thin rocky lip at the lower perimeter can suggest elevation, but avoid a floating island slab.
NO monsters, NO castle, NO towers, NO sockets, NO symbols, NO grid, NO HUD, NO text, NO frame, NO watermark. This is the final background only, used under moving sprites. Absolutely maintain the exact guide geometry so game entities follow the actual visible road. Rich coherent illustrated environment, not a flat colored plane.
prompts.cannon:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 8-direction TURNING CANNON TOP atlas for the reference woodland tower-defense game. Use reference only for cannon style/materials. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of equal grid cells. NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO frame, TRUE transparent background, no floor, no shadow, no stone platform, no grass, no scenery. Each cell contains ONLY the same chunky weathered bronze cannon turret top: squat rounded bronze breech, short broad tapered barrel, brass reinforcement bands, tiny rivets, dark recessed round muzzle. Match the richly shaded softly painted 3D miniatures of the reference.
Camera front aligned orthographic, looking down 42 degrees above ground. The turret stays upright; barrel turns horizontally around a vertical axis in actual 3D; never rotate the image plane. Lighting stays fixed from upper-left across all angles.
EXACT DIRECTION ORDER: upper row right/EAST, down-right/SOUTHEAST, down/SOUTH (muzzle toward viewer), down-left/SOUTHWEST. Lower row left/WEST, up-left/NORTHWEST, up/NORTH (barrel away from viewer, show rounded breech and rear), up-right/NORTHEAST.
REGISTRATION CRITICAL: every turret has the same world scale. The CENTER OF THE ROTATION AXIS is at 50% of each cell width and 60% of each cell height, in all eight cells. Barrel extends in its stated direction from that fixed center. Do not center the full silhouette independently in each cell. Leave enough transparent margin for the protruding barrel. Short compact shape; width when aimed horizontally about 72% of cell width, turret dome only about 28% cell width. All parts entirely within their cell, with clean gaps.
Subtle moss-free bronze, golden highlight on upper-left edges, dark lower-right body shading, small visible bore inside muzzle, restrained metal texture, no flat rectangular bar. Deliver a genuine 8-view atlas with corresponding anatomy, consistent body and pivot.
